name: arthovista-service-hub
description: ArthoVista centralized service hub — static hub + Company Registration, Manufacturing and Startup India sub-sites, with serverless enquiry endpoints under /api. This is a pre-built static site: there is no build step. "npm run dev" starts a local static preview (forms will not submit locally — the enquiry endpoints only run once deployed to Vercel, or under "vercel dev"). To deploy for real, use the Vercel CLI ("vercel") or connect this folder as a Vercel project.
